rules.USED_FOR: A source-supported task performed by the specific local method actor. A training objective may be retained only with taskRole=training_proxy, not advertised as a downstream application. An appositional family description alone does not inherit a specialized model's capability.
rules.EVALUATED_ON: A model or explicit inference strategy must have its own reported result attributable to the named dataset through recorded source-local coreference. Model components do not inherit overall-model scores.
rules.NO_RELATION: Scoped direct-operator contrast, not global incapability: retain only explicit object-versus-operator or explicitly partitioned module-output roles. Mere different components or training-only dataset mentions stay UNRESOLVED.
rules.evidence: Keep original contiguous endpoint-covering evidence; store separate exact predicate spans and coreference explanation. Never replace necessary attribution with a shorter but unsupported sentence.
rules.entityCoverage: Audit every existing mention, but quarantine documents with concrete unreviewed omission candidates instead of training omitted spans as O. No old entity boundaries are changed in this batch.
rules.duplicateSupport: Report mention-pair, distinct literal head-tail per paper, and source-paper counts separately. Do not assign duplicate mention pairs independent evidential weight.
